weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.9, with hypertension — start plan today:
 - Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie diet, target around 1600 kcal/day; replace sweet tea with unsweetened.
 - Walking about 30 minutes 5 days a week (neighborhood loop with wife).
 - Enrolling in the employer-sponsored weight management program with monthly coaching; RD visit through program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. HTN — BP 126/79 today on losartan 50 mg daily; continue.
3. GERD — stable on omeprazole.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 01/03/2026
Employer weight management program — RD intake.
Diet recall: large dinner plates, second helpings, sweet tea 2–3 glasses/day, fried foods several times a week. Enjoys cooking.
Plan: Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie approach at about 1600 kcal/day; 9-inch plate, half vegetables; bake/grill instead of frying; unsweetened tea; olive oil measured with a spoon. Monthly coaching call through program.
Activity: walking ~30 min, 5 days/week, as agreed with PCP.
Follow-up with RD in 6–8 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 03/13/2026
S: Weight and BP follow-up. Continues the diet and walking plan started in December; attending monthly coaching calls. Stopped sweet tea. Walks most days with his wife. Adherence good most weeks.
O: Wt 86.0 kg, BMI 29.8. BP 131/83.
A/P:
1. Overweight — continue program.
2. Hypertension — BP 131/83 on losartan 50 mg daily; continue; home BP log.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 06/04/2026
Food log reviewed: logging 5 days/week, adherent most days; weekend barbecues are the main challenge.
Adjustments: smaller portions of sides at barbecues, fill half plate with grilled vegetables; snack swap from chips to nuts (measured portion).
Reports he keeps up with the walking plan, ~5 days/week.
Continue program coaching.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/19/2026
S: Weight and BP follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and monthly program coaching since December. Walking 5 days a week, eating Mediterranean-style most days. Frustrated — weight 84.4 kg today vs 86.3 kg when the plan began in December (-2.2%), little change since spring despite reported adherence. Wants to discuss medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
Follow-up from urgent care: breathing fine with pre-exercise albuterol; no exertional chest pain.
O: Wt 84.4 kg, BMI 29.2. BP 135/88.
